Tennis Tool Center

SERVE TENNIS

 

Start using our suite of digital tools to manage tennis programs, tournaments, and business so you can automate administrative processes easily with online payments, player registration tools, and marketing and communication support.

HIGH SCHOOL

 

The High School Coaches’ Module in Serve Tennis helps make coaching your school tennis team a breeze. Use the module to manage your teams, schedule matches, enter scores right from the courts, and view previous match results and current standings.

NET GENERATION PLAY TRACKER

What is this?

NET GENERATION PLAY TRACKER

What is this?

Your child leveled up to Orange! They can now play in Orange Ball events. They can also continue to play and improve in Red Ball events.

Your child leveled up to Green! They can now play in Green Ball events. They can also continue to play and improve in Red and Orange Ball events.

Your child can compete in Yellow Ball events, including 12U ranked USTA Junior Tournaments. We encourange your child to play in Green Ball events until they’re ready to move to Yellow Ball competition. Remember, it's not a race to the yellow ball.

Your child will be able to compete in Orange Ball events when they either turn five or when their coach believes they are ready. LEARN MORE

Your child will be able to compete in Green Ball events when they either turn 9 years old or when they earn 1000 orange play points or when their coach believes they are ready. LEARN MORE

FIND PLAY

Guide Your Child’s Play and Have Fun Along the Way, with the Net Generation PlayTracker

The PlayTracker is a tool that will help guide your child’s journey through tennis and ensure they are playing the right programs and events for their age and skill level.

Safe Play™ For Parents

The USTA is committed to promoting safe and respectful environments for athletes to thrive in. Safe PlayTM is the comprehensive athlete safety program consisting of education, screening, reporting tools and policies for appropriate conduct in tennis. The USTA works with the U.S. Center for SafeSport and the United States Olympic & Paralympic Committee to develop Safe PlayTM policies, procedures and educational resources to support the program.

Parent’s Guide to Misconduct in Sport

Designed for parents of youth athletes at any age, this free course educates parents on recognizing, responding to, and preventing abuse.

 

Learn More

Abuse Prevention for Adult Athletes

This course summarizes valuable athlete safety concepts—cultural, technical, and legal—with real-world examples relevant to adult athletes.

 

Learn More

SafeSport for Volunteers

Volunteers provide invaluable support, spirit, and leadership. But however infrequent or informal their engagement, they have critical positions to play to support and reinforce athlete safety.

 

Learn More
